## How we research and write

Every trip, price and travel detail on Egyphoria starts from firsthand knowledge of Egypt — our founders have been arranging Egyptian travel for more than six years — checked against current entry requirements, opening hours and official pricing where they exist.

## How we keep it current

Prices and rate cards are marked with an "as of" date wherever they appear. We review trip pages, the help center and the trip cost estimator whenever underlying prices or rules change, and at minimum once per season.

## How to report an error

If something on the site looks out of date or incorrect, email hello@egyphoria.com with the page link and what looks wrong. We review every report and correct confirmed errors promptly.
